row:
Welcome to Healing touch by Yuvraj — a journey through wellness, travel, and the life of a modern massage therapist.
Here, I share:
💆‍♂️ My daily client bookings & therapy schedule
✈️ Travel vlogs as I move city to city for sessions
🏨 Hotel stays, airport check-ins & on-the-go work life
🥘 Local food explorations during my trips
🌆 Behind-the-scenes of a travelling massage therapist
If you love wellness, lifestyle, travel, and raw real-life experiences — you’re in the right place.
Subscribe and join my journey as I balance healing people and exploring India, one city at a time.
